description: This file implements the MediaKeys class and related factory functions for managing media key sessions, including creation, deletion, and querying of key sessions, with logging and error handling.

classes.name: MediaKeys
classes.description: Implements media key session management, including creation, deletion, and querying, with support for different key systems and logging.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to a new MediaKeysFactory instance.

methods.name: createMediaKeys
methods.description: Creates a new media keys instance for a given key system.

methods.name: MediaKeys constructor
methods.description: Initializes a MediaKeys object with a key system and IPC factory, creating the IPC interface.

methods.name: MediaKeys destructor
methods.description: Resets the IPC interface and performs cleanup.

methods.name: selectKeyId
methods.description: Updates the key ID for a session and returns success or failure.

methods.name: containsKey
methods.description: Checks if a key exists for a given session and key ID.

methods.name: createKeySession
methods.description: Creates a new key session with specified parameters, adding session to KeyIdMap if PlayReady.

methods.name: generateRequest
methods.description: Generates a license request for a session.

methods.name: loadSession
methods.description: Loads an existing session.

methods.name: updateSession
methods.description: Updates a session with response data.

methods.name: setDrmHeader
methods.description: Sets DRM header data for a session.

methods.name: closeKeySession
methods.description: Closes a session and removes it from KeyIdMap if PlayReady.

methods.name: removeKeySession
methods.description: Removes a session.

methods.name: deleteDrmStore
methods.description: Deletes the DRM store.

methods.name: deleteKeyStore
methods.description: Deletes the key store.

methods.name: getDrmStoreHash
methods.description: Retrieves the hash of the DRM store.

methods.name: getKeyStoreHash
methods.description: Retrieves the hash of the key store.

methods.name: getLdlSessionsLimit
methods.description: Retrieves the limit for LDL sessions.

methods.name: getLastDrmError
methods.description: Retrieves the last DRM error for a session.

methods.name: getDrmTime
methods.description: Retrieves the current DRM time.

methods.name: getCdmKeySessionId
methods.description: Retrieves the CDM key session ID for a given session.
